title: sqlite-utils 4.0rc2, mostly written by Claude Fable (for about $149.25)
summary: Simon Willison released sqlite-utils 4.0rc2, a Python library for manipulating SQLite databases, with approximately 80% of the code written by Claude Fable (an AI coding assistant) at a cost of about $149.25, demonstrating the practical viability of AI-assisted software development for real-world projects.
problem_solved: Demonstrates the practical cost and workflow of using AI coding assistants to develop production-quality open source software.
why_valuable: Provides a concrete case study with actual costs showing how AI tools can meaningfully contribute to real software development, not just simple tasks.
